newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary February jobless rise seasonal - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Hungary February jobless rise seasonal - ministry.

text.p: Unemployment in Hungary rose to 11.1 percent in February from 10.6 percent the previous month but the Labour Ministry said the rise was caused by temporary factors and did not reflect an underlying growth.
Ministry data released on Wedneday put Hungary's unemployed at 498,080, in February, compared to 474,500 the month before and 530,592, or 11.6 percent, in February 1996.
